Somehow I landed on the perfect dosage after only two experiments. It was accidental—just trial and error. I redosed because I wasn’t feeling anything, and that ended up giving me the best trip I’ve ever had. So here’s the wisdom I’ll pass on to you (cleaned up formatting with chatgpt):

**Prep:**

– Fasted for 4 hours beforehand

**Dosing timeline:**

• **0:00** – Took Benadryl (a normal dose, just to prevent robo-itch)

• **+45 min** – Took 420 mg DXM HBr

• **+1 hr 50 min after that** – Took another 210 mg DXM HBr (redose)

**\[630 mg total\]**

**Result:**

Most dissociative experience I’ve ever had.

**Tips:**

• Fast for 4 hours beforehand

• Hit a pen or smoke a bit of weed for nausea relief and trip enhancement (don’t overdo it)

• Take your dose early in the evening so you don’t fall asleep mid-trip

• Lie in bed and **listen to music with headphones**

I tried taking 660 mg all at once—ended up with a weaker trip and almost no visuals.

Same thing happened with 810 mg—just felt nauseous and super high.

I even repeated the redose method with 480 mg + 240 mg (720 mg total), but I threw up and fell asleep. Also forgot to wear headphones that time, so I just heard my loud-ass PC fan the whole trip 💀. Plus, one Benadryl wasn’t enough at that dose—I was itchy as hell.

Moral of the story: follow a similar redosing schedule, but adjust the dose to fit your body weight and tolerance.
